fragments.text:
Dear AC/SPC, the contribution combines strong sign-based optimization with an analysis of where to place sign compression and error feedback. On federated CNN2/CIFAR-10 (11 IID clients, 5 seeds), SignMuon achieves 85.72% at 1 bit per matrix entry, versus Muon 85.98% and SignSGD 81.44%. On centralized ResNet18/CIFAR-10 (3 seeds), it reaches 94.60% versus Muon 94.35% and SignSGD 93.37%.

In response to the reviews, we added CNN2/CIFAR-10 tests with 11 Dirichlet(0.1) clients, 2000 rounds, no local updates and the IID-selected rates. **EF21-MuonSign reaches 83.23±0.36% and EF21-MuonUSign 82.99±0.46%** (5 seeds). They are the only Muon variants above 80% here; Muon reaches 46.02% and SignMuon 35.92%. The full 10-method table is in our reply to 7S1b, Q2. This shows why the useful error-feedback placement depends on the data regime.

After submission, we extended gradient-side EF21 convergence to fixed EMA/Nesterov and constant/cosine learning rates, with core proofs verified in Lean; separable layers remain assumed. We also proved conditional SignMuon convergence for interacting layers when signing preserves enough alignment with momentum; network verification remains open.

The failure analysis has also been strengthened. Composing the linear objectives with softplus makes them smooth and lower bounded, while positive gradient rescaling preserves the ascent directions for all 3 plain sign placements. For Tx34, a separate exact-polar EF21-SignMuon construction gives 8×8 convex quadratics with Frobenius smoothness 1, initial gap 4/7 and gradient norm ≥1 at every iterate, for any constant rate and fixed EMA/Nesterov momentum chosen for the budget. It also covers strictly decreasing steps to zero without momentum and power decay with fixed momentum; its exact algebraic certificate has been checked.

For Ueq5 and pqje, the submitted CNN2/CIFAR-10 logs reproduce A8: MuonSign 82.94±0.19% versus SignSGD 81.44±0.15%. We will correct the main table, its reversed comparison and the invalid squaring of an expected-norm rate. We ask that the measured algorithmic contribution and these completed additions be weighed together.

Optional scientific synthesis checked against E1/E3/E4/N1/G1/T1. No reliance on J1. Actual confidential field limit/readers remain unknown. New transfer evidence: E5, 50 independently recomputed run histories.
Readability revision: claims about Lean refer to original failure results and EF21 core proofs; see F1. The confidential field limit remains unknown.
Revision 4 foregrounds post-submission heterogeneous results and theory extensions. The full table is in 7S1b Q2. Lean verification covers the core EF21 proofs and original failure results, not the separate conditional SignMuon theorem. Field limit remains unknown.
Revision 5: named every vision setup, highlighted the two EF results, scoped the only-success claim to Muon variants above 80% in the reused-rate test, and explained softplus composition. Core EF21 proofs and original ascent results retain their separate Lean scope; the softplus and N4 extensions are not claimed Lean-verified.
